title: My body and senses

parent.learn: Names of body parts: head, eyes, ears, nose, mouth, hands, fingers, legs, feet.
parent.why: Knowing the names lets the child tell you where it hurts and follow instructions like “wash your hands”.

parent.learn: Five senses: eyes see, ears hear, nose smells, tongue tastes, skin feels.
parent.why: These are the only ways we learn about the world — every fact the child knows came in through one of them.

parent.learn: Wash hands before eating and after the toilet.
parent.why: Germs are too small to see but can make us ill. Soap and water wash them away before they get into the mouth.

parent.learn: Our body needs food, water, sleep and play.
parent.why: Food and water give energy and help us grow; sleep lets the body rest and repair.

ask: Touch your nose. Now your knees. Now your elbows.
Close your eyes: what can you hear?
Smell this (a flower, a spice). Is it nice?
Taste this: is it sweet, salty or sour?
Touch this ice cube: hot or cold?
Why do we wash our hands before eating?
How many fingers do you have in all?

rounds.h: Our eyes let us see colours and shapes.
We breathe in smells through our nose.

rounds.t: How many fingers are on one hand?

rounds.h: Legs and feet carry us when we walk and run.
The tongue tells sweet, salty and sour.

rounds.t: We feel hot and cold with our…
rounds.h: Our skin feels touch, heat and cold.

rounds.t: How many eyes do we have?
rounds.h: One on each side of the nose: 2.

rounds.t: Which body part helps you hold a pencil?
rounds.h: Fingers on the hand hold and grip things.
Teeth cut and grind food so we can swallow it.

rounds.t: You smell a flower with your…
rounds.h: Smell is the sense of the nose.

rounds.t: You hear a bell with your…
rounds.h: A ringing sound goes into the ears.

rounds.t: Why do we wash our hands before eating?
rounds.h: Germs on our hands could go into our mouth with the food. Soap washes them off.

rounds.t: Which sense tells you that ice is cold?
rounds.h: Our skin feels the cold when we touch the ice.

rounds.t: How many senses do we have?
